name: Relay Runner
blurb: Daily trainer with a soft foam ride.
detail: A lightweight daily trainer. Engineered mesh upper, cushioned foam midsole, and a rubber outsole patterned for wet pavement. True to size.

name: Signal Low
blurb: A low court shoe in a loud red.
detail: Leather and synthetic upper, cupsole, and a padded collar. Made for the street, not the track. Runs slightly narrow.

name: Court White
detail: Full-grain leather upper, stitched foxing, and a cream midsole. The pair you wear with everything. Wipe clean with a damp cloth.

name: Night Mesh
detail: Stripped-back racer with a breathable mesh upper and a responsive foam stack. Best for faster efforts. Sale price while this colorway lasts.

name: Field Boot
blurb: Pull-on boot with a lug sole.
detail: Oiled leather upper, elastic side gores, and a commando lug sole. Breaks in over a week. Weather resistant, not waterproof.

name: Clay Court
detail: Suede upper, vulcanized sole, and a low profile. Brush the nap, don’t soak it. Half size up if you wear thick socks.

name: Studio High
blurb: High-top with a soft bone leather.
detail: Padded high collar, leather upper, and a cupsole that keeps the silhouette sharp. Looks heavy, wears light.

name: Trail Knit
blurb: Knit trail shoe with a grippy outsole.
detail: Knit upper with a toe cap, rockered midsole, and a trail lug. For fire roads and easy singletrack, not technical mud.

name: Mono Leather
detail: Smooth leather, minimal branding, and a leather lining. The dress-up sneaker. Use a neutral cream, not oil.

name: Harbor Knit
blurb: Lightweight knit, this color is gone.
detail: A knit lifestyle shoe from the last drop. This colorway is sold out. Join the list on the next restock — for this test shop, stock stays at zero.

name: Canvas Low
detail: Cotton canvas, vulcanized sole, and a removable insole. Washes up after a summer. Size down if you are between sizes.
